gloss: reading room (in a library or archive)

definitions.gloss: reading room (in a library or archive)
definitions.explanation: A designated room in libraries, archives, or institutions where visitors can read or consult materials.

examples.japanese: {閲覧室|えつらんしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be quiet in the reading room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I studied in the library's reading room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: These materials can only be used in the reading room.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{閲覧|えつらん}→閲覧：17691_etsuran⟧ (reading/browsing) and ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Found in libraries, archives, museums, and other institutions where reference materials are available for on-site consultation. Signs reading {閲覧室|えつらんしつ} are common in Japanese libraries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閲覧室|えつらんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use the reading room
- {閲覧室|えつらんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{閲覧|えつらん}する→閲覧する：18280_etsuransuru⟧: to browse/read in the reading room
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}: general reading room
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}: special collections reading room

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{閲覧|えつらん}→閲覧：17691_etsuran⟧: reading, browsing — the act itself
- ⟦{書庫|しょこ}→書庫：16230_shoko⟧: stacks, book storage — where books are stored (as opposed to read)
